_comment: PRESSUPOSTO L0 demo of barrier_search (Koopman 1946/1980; Washburn 2002). Crossing window 1.20 h matches the Nansei benchmark detection window (12 NM @ 10 kn) from examples/benchmarks/nansei_jcg — problem statement / reference only. Barrier length and sweep width here are PRESSUPOSTO placeholders for a choke-line patrol, NOT the Gabbiano radar's real sweep width (that Nansei sub-point remains open: needs a sourced datasheet W). Not a product study.
